title: Audit documentation policy review — Kessler LLP
instructions: Kessler LLP audits only nonissuers. Review the draft documentation policy and correct each underlined statement that is inconsistent with AU-C 230.

parts.prompt: Select the correct wording for each highlighted phrase.

segments.text:
**Kessler LLP — Audit documentation policy (draft)**

1. The final audit file must be assembled within

segments.explanation: AU-C 230 sets the documentation completion date at no later than 60 days after the report release date.

segments.text:
after the report release date.

2. After the documentation completion date, superseded drafts

options: must be sent to the client
segments.explanation: After the completion date, documentation may not be deleted or discarded before the end of the retention period.

segments.text:
.

3. Audit documentation is retained for at least

segments.explanation: AU-C 230 requires retention for at least five years from the report release date.

segments.text:
from the report release date.

4. If documentation is added after the report release date, the staff member records

options: when and by whom it was added and why
segments.answer: when and by whom it was added and why
segments.explanation: Additions after the report date must show when, by whom, the reasons and their effect.
The standard is an experienced auditor with no previous connection to the audit.

segments.text: with no previous connection to the audit to understand the work performed.
